vc_checking.summary: All 27 current manual witnesses are semantically proofable under the annotation-approved predicates. Seven result-classification witnesses reduce to predicate unfolding and branch guards; eight setup entailments recover descriptor/actual-length facts and split the ring/input arrays; four successful returns construct exact wrap or contiguous after-lists and prove CircularAreaRingUpdate; two early returns select the error/zero-length branches; three partial-solve witnesses are bounded sublist-length facts; and two callable/body derivations instantiate identical logical states. No annotation/spec repair is required. The successful-return family, and optionally the intermediate sublist decomposition witness, should use proved group-local case_lib helpers for list/ring-update facts.

natural_language_analysis.summary: For every target, the precondition owns every spatial resource requested by the postcondition, either unchanged or as full arrays that can be split/merged into the generated segment layout. All branch facts follow from guards plus the four seed predicates. The only nontrivial mathematical work is the list-level characterization of the ring after one or two memcpy operations; its premises are exactly the descriptor bounds, array lengths, actual-write relation, and wrap/no-wrap guard present in the corresponding VCs.
